about: The cartoon direction in docs/botl-art.md (the Ghibli facade restyle) and README.md. cottage-facade.webp is the restyled facade and summer-sky.webp the sky it was made with.
prompt: A soft, hand-painted look like a Studio Ghibli film: clean ink contours and broad gouache shapes in seafoam, mint, honey oak and cream, with sunlit summer light. Simplified detail, without realistic grain or grunge.
